instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: ReturnCedar Damage Ledger reviews reported damage to returned rental items and records resulting deposit adjustments. Return Clerks create review records, Return Inspectors record damage and evidence, Renters acknowledge or dispute reports, Damage Assessors record responsibility and proposed deductions, and Rental Account Officers record final adjustments and send outcomes. Damage categories and the delivery channel remain unresolved; repair scheduling and payment collection are excluded.

Damage categories and the outcome delivery channel remain unresolved, while repair scheduling and payment collection are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Review reported rental-item damage and record the resulting deposit adjustment after renter and assessor input.
